purpose: 实际先登记不同银行贷款审批条件原字段与当前表头/季度行/方法，全部原目标保持，网络与金融预算0
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
import json,hashlib,re
root=Path.cwd();parent=root/'reports/research/510300_bankers_loan_demand_joint_score_v1'
source=root/'reports/research/510300_bankers_loan_demand_source_qualification_v1'
out=root/'reports/research/510300_bank_loan_approval_conditions_source_v1';out.mkdir(exist_ok=True,parents=True)
now=datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
def readj(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def ident(p):
 b=p.read_bytes();return {'path':p.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()}
priorfiles=['research/historical_index_liquidity_transmission_v1.py','research/registered_factors.py','research/round2_mechanism_factors.py','research/factor96_library_intake_v1.py',
 'config/factor_registry.yaml','config/factor_registry_round2.yaml','config/factor_registry_round3.yaml','config/factor_registry_round4.yaml',
 'reports/research/510300_bank_industry_constraint_source_probe_v1/result.json',
 'reports/research/510300_bank_current_vintage_ratio_cause_identity_v1/result.json',
 'reports/research/510300_bank_release_vintage_and_nim_definition_probe_v1/result.json',
 'reports/research/510300_bankers_loan_demand_source_qualification_v1/protocol.json',
 'reports/research/510300_bankers_loan_demand_joint_score_v1/protocol.json',
 'reports/research/510300_bankers_loan_demand_joint_score_v1/result.json',
 'docs/PROJECT_STATE.md','docs/RESEARCH_DECISIONS.md']
prior=[]
for rel in priorfiles:
 p=root/rel;body=p.read_bytes().decode('utf-8-sig')
 hits=[{'position':m.start(),'context':body[max(0,m.start()-100):m.end()+230]} for m in re.finditer(r'贷款审批|银行.{0,8}审批|loan[_ -]?approval',body,re.I)]
 prior.append({**ident(p),'full_text_read':True,'all_target_keyword_contexts':hits})
prev=readj(parent/'protocol.json');assert '银行贷款审批指数' not in prev['fixed_model_plan']['added_features']
proposal=readj(parent/'next_experiment.json')
gate=readj(source/'source_gate_v1_0_1.json');assert gate['source_gate_passed']
proto={
 'study_id':proposal['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E80','registered_at':now,
 'status':'REGISTERED_DIFFERENT_BANK_LOAN_APPROVAL_CONDITION_ORIGINAL_SOURCE_ONLY',
 'previous_goal_turn_classification':'PROGRESS_E76_BANK_BUFFER_DEFINITION_AND_LIMITS_E77_COMPLETE_DIFFERENT_LOAN_DEMAND_SOURCE_E78_FIXED_MODEL_REJECTED_E79_ALL_SIGNAL_COST_LEAF_DIAGNOSIS',
 'question':proposal['question'],'target_field':'银行贷款审批指数','original_method':'认为本行本季贷款审批条件放松的占比加基本不变占比的一半，当前原定义必须实际核；不是贷款审批通过率。',
 'target_quarters':proposal['target_quarters'],'current_report_only':'原该季度报告的原银行家问卷指数表、银行贷款审批这一列、该当前季度行、百分比单位。后来报告的历史行不补值，不从需求列或政策感受列代替。',
 'table_contract':'原表完整表头与当前季度行对应，列名定位/列数/单位/原方法保存。普通正文跨列或2020Q4重字无法可靠读数时仅核同一原页，不猜重复数字。',
 'source_contract':'复用已取得29当前原问卷和真实公布页/附件及原元日期，但审批字段的当前值/表头/方法/母体自己核。该原来源保守历史重构，首版/真正首次公开时点尚未认证。已知晚版/缺字段不能补0。',
 'full_support_contract':'全部1711原成员/1212当前和原成熟池保持；原公开季度/时间/信息龄展示，问卷状态不冒充每天真实供给，缺季度/版本不拖旧值或删成员。',
 'prior_use_qualification':prior,'finite_prior_use_verdict':'十六原件完整读取。当前文档中的E80提案、原方法/原表字样不是已做金融实验；E78实际新增仅贷款总体需求原百分数。原银行约束/比率/NIM及旧贷款数量实验的失败保持；不宣称全repo无旧用途。',
 'same_field_same_financial_use_found_in_these_finite_files':False,'if_same_frozen_use_found':'立即结束同用途，不改名/组合/窗口营救。',
 'network_budget':0,'new_equity_labels':0,'new_model_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,
 'financial_registration':'当前不选择金融表达，来源和不同用途以及全部原成员支持成立才另登记唯一审批信息金融候选。原贷款需求表达E78拒绝不重开。',
 'parents':[ident(parent/'next_experiment.json'),ident(parent/'result.json'),ident(parent/'固定失败归因_信号费用与原叶.json'),
 ident(source/'source_gate_v1_0_1.json'),ident(source/'全部29当前原字段方法_目视补全_v1_0_1.json'),
 ident(source/'全部29原问卷全文与目标当前值方法.json'),ident(source/'全部原报告PDF首次本地取得回执.json')],
 'only_executable_assets':['510300.SH','CASH_CNY'],'orders_authorized':False,'historical_only':True,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,
 'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','goal_achieved':False,'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'old_rejections_preserved':True}
for name,obj in [('protocol.json',proto),('实际旧字段用途资格.json',{'completed_at':now,'study_id':proto['study_id'],'records':prior,'verdict':proto['finite_prior_use_verdict'],'same_field_same_financial_use_found':False})]:
 p=out/name;assert not p.exists(),'已有原件不覆盖';p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print('E80已实际登记；十六旧原件完整核对，同字段同金融用途未定位；原文提案/方法字样不当旧实验。')
print('复用全29原附件/公布页；新网络/股票标签/拟合/账户/源码均0。')
